VALIDITY CONCERN. The stated 966 km length and 42/48/56-inch multi-diameter set are trunk-line scale, not a single-origin gathering segment, and closely echo the figures reported for Aramco's east-west Master Gas System / Abqaiq-Yanbu trunk corridor (e.g. the ~1,200 km, 48/56-inch East-West line built 1981, and the 1,170 km Shedgum-Yanbu NGL line). An 'A47'-to-Yanbu line of 966 km with three large diameters is not confirmed by any independent source and may be a mis-segmentation or duplication of the documented MGS/NGL trunk system under a cryptic 'A47' label (A-numbers are Aramco gas-plant/station codes). Recommend human review: confirm whether this row is a genuine distinct segment or a duplicate/relabel of the Master Gas System / Shedgum-Yanbu trunk before relying on the length/diameter. Not silently changed.

VALIDITY NOTE. 'Berri-Abu Ali Gas Pipeline' (8-inch, 39 km) is one of a near-identical Berri-Abu Ali pair (P1922 8-inch and P1923 10-inch), both 39 km, same Al Jubail->Abu Ali Island routing, both feeding off Berri Gas Plant. The pair is plausible (parallel small lines of differing diameter are common), but no independent source confirms either segment individually, its 39 km length, the 8 vs 10-inch split, or that two separate gas lines (vs one) exist on this route. A web-search note: independent coverage of 'Abu Ali-Berri' references a 22 km, 30-inch gas line (2008) and large 30-36-inch crude/condensate lines from the Berri increment program - none matching the 39 km, 8/10-inch figures here. Recommend human review of the source of these dimensions and whether the two rows are genuinely distinct. Not silently changed.
